candidate.answerReason: The figure shows A, B, C collinear and D on segment BE. Triangle ABE gives an 80° angle at B, so triangle BDC has angles 100°, 30°, and 50°.

methods.label: Find the angles at B first
methods.explanation:
The two triangles are connected by the straight line through \(A,B,C\), so first find the angle at \(B\) in triangle \(ABE\). The angles of a triangle sum to \(180^\circ\), giving
\[
\angle ABE=180^\circ-60^\circ-40^\circ=80^\circ.
\]
Since \(D\) lies on segment \(BE\), \(\angle ABD=80^\circ\). Rays \(BA\) and \(BC\) point in opposite directions, so the adjacent angles \(ABD\) and \(DBC\) sum to \(180^\circ\). Thus
\[
\angle DBC=180^\circ-80^\circ=100^\circ.
\]
Now use the angle sum in triangle \(BDC\):
\[
\angle BDC=180^\circ-100^\circ-30^\circ=50^\circ.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{50^\circ}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
